dataset_partition: DEVELOPMENT_EXPOSED_ONLY (COMP112, DEV37, PROBES39, STAGE_P1_WAVE_PROBES 24, and exposed REAL27 text + images); zero access to sealed H-1 or locked W2/W3
expected_behavior: Evaluate all 27 exposed REAL27 items on both Text (baseline 15/27 visualized, 12/27 numeric answer-key match, 3/27 GOAL_VISUALIZATION_READY_NUMERIC_NOT_ANSWERED) and Image via local OCR (prepare_unified_input -> scripted confirmation of flagged spans only -> route_text_input; baseline 9/27 visualized, 6/27 numeric answer-key match, 3/27 GOAL_VISUALIZATION_READY_NUMERIC_NOT_ANSWERED) with 0 live AI calls; highlight vmmu_r537, vmmu_r460, vmmu_r463, and vmmu_r266; preserve output-policy/1 numeric withholding; verify exact hand-oracles and proof certificates; and confirm wrong_scene_served == 0.
actual_behavior: REAL27 Text improved from 15/27 -> 18/27 visualized and 12/27 -> 15/27 learner-visible numeric answer-key match (unlocking vmmu_r537 -> 'a√6/3' [key C], vmmu_r460 -> 'a³√2/3' [key C], vmmu_r463 -> '4a³√3' [key D]; 3/27 trig-value questions remain GOAL_VISUALIZATION_READY_NUMERIC_NOT_ANSWERED under output-policy/1; vmmu_r266 remains SAFE_REFUSAL / EXACT_DOMAIN_EXCEEDED / CAPABILITY_UNSUPPORTED). REAL27 Image improved from 9/27 -> 10/27 visualized and 6/27 -> 7/27 learner-visible numeric answer-key match. wrong_scene_served == 0 on both Text and Image; 0 broken scene invariants.
mathematical_oracle: VMMU dataset answer keys + independent closed-form hand derivations: vmmu_r537: regular pyramid S.ABCD, S_ABCD=a² => AB=a, SO=a/√2, d(A,(SBC))=a√6/3 (key C); vmmu_r460: right-isosceles △ABC at B with AC=2a => AB=BC=a√2, △SAB right-isosceles at A => SA=a√2, V=a³√2/3 (key C); vmmu_r463: right prism ABCD.A'B'C'D', rhombus ABCD with ∠BAD=60°, AA'=2a, ∠(AC',(ABCD))=30° => AC=AA'·cot(30°)=2a√3 => AB=2a, BD=2a => S_ABCD=2a²√3 => V=S_ABCD·AA'=4a³√3 (key D '4√3a³'); vmmu_r266: non-special degree angle outside algebraic exact trig table => honest EXACT_DOMAIN_EXCEEDED.

source_provenance.numeric_not_answered_rule: GOAL_VISUALIZATION_READY_NUMERIC_NOT_ANSWERED (when source_goal_completion is present under output-policy/1) is NEVER counted as a numeric answer-key match.
